name: Van Rensselaer Square Shopping Center
summary: Van Rensselaer Square Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood retail destination in Rensselaer, NY, serving the Capital District community with convenient shopping options. With a 4.5-star rating from nearly 1,000 reviews, this center has earned its reputation as a reliable local shopping hub.
demographics: Van Rensselaer Square Shopping Center serves the Rensselaer, NY community and surrounding Capital District area, attracting a diverse mix of middle-income families, young professionals, and retirees. The trade area draws from both the city of Rensselaer and neighboring Albany suburbs, with shoppers typically seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services. The center appeals to value-conscious consumers and local residents looking for accessible shopping options within a traditional neighborhood setting.
description: Van Rensselaer Square Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination located at 4730 West Sand Lake Road in Rensselaer, New York. Serving the Capital District region since its development, this shopping center has established itself as a reliable neighborhood retail hub for local residents and visitors alike. The center maintains convenient operating hours from 8:30 AM to 8:30 PM, providing accessible shopping throughout the day for the surrounding community. With a strong 4.5-star rating based on 967 reviews, Van Rensselaer Square has built a reputation for delivering consistent service and meeting the everyday needs of its shoppers. The property is managed by EDC, a full-service commercial construction and development firm founded in 1990, which brings decades of expertise in creating and maintaining quality retail environments that prioritize client and tenant satisfaction.
